verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm offering legal services plus static resources (glossaries, FAQs, document generators), not a platform where users build automations. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The 'Automated Convertible Note' is a one-off document generator, not a user-managed automation with versioning or rollback, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
